```{r}
#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "report.R"))
SRSRuns <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(SiteTable)), function(i) {
  .resolveReportSRS(
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    root = root,
    context = "SRS chapter"
  )
})
```

# Seismic Record Selection {#sec-srs}

## Executive Summary {#sec-srs_summary}

{{< include /_chapters/srs.summary.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/srs_summary.qmd",
    stem = "srs-summary",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = SRSRuns[[i]],
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-srs-summary-site",
    context = "SRS summary"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
